title: The First Principles Method Explained by Elon Musk
summary: A short excerpt of Elon Musk, interviewed by Kevin Rose, explaining first-principles reasoning with the example of the car versus improving horse carriages. He warns it takes much more mental energy than reasoning by analogy.
why: HN cites it as the standard illustration of reasoning from first principles, including his battery cost example.

quote.text: Reason from First principles is extremely useful for identifying new waves that will carry you in the future with no effort.
